title: Nondeterministic machine replay
statement: Given a nondeterministic machine with $k$ work tapes, Boolean symbols, and state set $S$, construct a deterministic machine with $k+1$ work tapes and the same initial state. At each step, it reads the last work tape's scanned Boolean value as the choice bit, treating a blank as false, and uses that choice to select the original machine's transition; the original $k$ work-tape actions, input movement, output, and successor state are retained, while the added tape is left unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $k$ of work tapes
A nondeterministic machine over Boolean symbols with state set $S$
